en:
## New Features

- Add remote executor devices: route a narrator's file/command tools (Read/Write/Edit/Glob/Grep/Bash) and terminals to a remote machine via a lightweight companion executor, with reverse-dial and direct connection modes, resumable chunked file transfer, and a remote PTY terminal runtime.
- Add a unified outbound proxy overrides page, letting you review and edit per-AI-provider, per-gateway-platform, per-hook, and per-tool proxy overrides in one place.
- Add a per-provider User-Agent mode (default, Claude Code, Codex, or custom string) for Anthropic/OpenAI-compatible providers.
- Add Codex gpt-5.6-sol/terra/luna models with a real "max" reasoning tier.
- Add an option to queue newly sent messages until an in-progress context compaction finishes, instead of sending immediately.

## Performance

- Speed up startup after an unclean shutdown: probe each FTS index with a cheap integrity check and only rebuild the ones that actually fail, instead of unconditionally rebuilding every index.

## Bug Fixes

- Fix model-list and chat requests silently masking the real error from your configured endpoint behind an unrelated 404 or dropped connection from an automatic `/v1` fallback retry; the real endpoint's error is now preserved and surfaced first.
- Fix several \"Refresh models\" buttons (Anthropic, Custom API, NUG, OpenAI providers) showing an empty error message on failure; they now display the actual error.
- Fix manual `/bash` commands (including command-first custom slash commands) not being stoppable from the UI; the Stop button now terminates them too.

## UI/UX

- Move the tool-call terminate control into the header as a small inline icon, shown for the entire duration a tool is running instead of only after 60 seconds.
zh-CN:
## 新功能

- 新增远程执行器设备：可将叙述者的文件/命令工具（Read/Write/Edit/Glob/Grep/Bash）与终端路由到远程机器上执行，通过轻量级配套执行器完成，支持反向拨号与直连两种连接模式、可续传的分块文件传输，以及远程 PTY 终端运行时。
- 新增统一的出站代理覆盖管理页面，可在一处集中查看和编辑各 AI 提供商、网关平台、hook、工具的代理覆盖设置。
- Anthropic/OpenAI 兼容提供商新增按提供商设置 User-Agent 模式（默认、Claude Code、Codex 或自定义字符串）。
- 新增 Codex gpt-5.6-sol/terra/luna 模型，支持真正的 "最高" 推理等级。
- 新增选项：正在压缩上下文时，新发送的消息可选择排队等待压缩完成后再发送，而不是立即发送。

## 性能优化

- 加快非正常关闭后的启动速度：对每个全文索引先做一次低成本完整性探测，只重建真正损坏的索引，不再无条件重建全部索引。

## 修复

- 修复模型列表与聊天请求中，配置端点返回的真实错误会被自动 `/v1` 回退重试触发的无关 404 或连接中断悄悄掩盖的问题；现在会保留并优先展示真实端点的错误。
- 修复多个\"刷新模型\"按钮（Anthropic、Custom API、NUG、OpenAI 提供商）失败时只显示空错误消息的问题，现在会展示实际错误内容。
- 修复手动 `/bash` 命令（包括先执行命令的自定义斜杠命令）无法在界面上被终止的问题，现在 Stop 按钮也能终止它们。

## 界面优化

- 工具调用的终止按钮改为 header 内的小图标，只要工具在运行就一直展示，不再要求先等待 60 秒。
